title: Convolution reverb
description: Puts the sound in a real space: it is convolved with an impulse response (a WAV file of the project), for example a room, a plate or a street.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.doc: Off passes the sound through untouched (bypass).

parameters.name: ir
parameters.doc: Where the impulse response comes from: file is the file below (any WAV of the project, or pack:<pack>/<name>); the others are the ready-made ones of the impulse-responses pack (room, hall, plate, church, street; make it with tools/make-impulse-responses.mjs) and the real CC0 recordings real-stairwell, real-garage, real-car, real-basement, real-microverb (tools/fetch-impulse-responses-real.mjs).

parameters.name: file
parameters.doc: Project-relative impulse response (a recording of a clap, a sweep or a space), or pack:<pack>/<name>. Used when ir is file.
parameters.placeholder: choose an impulse response of the project

parameters.name: mix
parameters.doc: How much of the convolved sound is mixed with the dry sound.

parameters.name: length
parameters.doc: How much of the impulse response is used.

parameters.name: level
parameters.doc: Level of the convolved sound before mixing.

parameters.name: normalize
parameters.doc: On scales the response to a standard energy, so different responses sound about equally loud.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: An impulse response WAV file of the project (parameter file).
